learning_from.description: The learner's best/explanation language. Every registered learn-from language may participate when its localized source bridge exists.

learning_language_full.description: A Tier 1 or Tier 2 target with a researched family-system profile, representative terms, structured distinctions, cultural cautions, examples, and full lesson practice.

learning_language_game_core.description: Any canonical learn-from language may be a Family Members vocabulary-game target. The game core covers the same fourteen relationship slots in all 104 languages and permits multiple target forms where the language requires a finer distinction.
required_assets: at least one non-empty form per concept

learning_language_comparison.description: Every canonical learn-from language may participate in the vocabulary comparison layer when its game-core record exists. Tier 3 comparison/game capability does not imply a full authored language course.

runtime_model.source_first: Show the localized bridge in the learner's best available explanation language before teaching the target system.
runtime_model.full_target: For a Tier 1/Tier 2 target, resolve the structured target profile plus its game-core record and render the longer explanation, relationship distinctions, cultural caution, examples, and practice.
runtime_model.game_target: For any of the 104 languages, resolve the game-core record and build relationship-safe vocabulary games. Multiple forms must remain distinguishable when they encode age, side, speaker gender, or another required relationship feature.
runtime_model.pair_scaling: Do not author a 104 x 104 matrix. Source copy, full target profiles, and universal game-core vocabulary are independent assets joined at runtime.
runtime_model.fallback: If a full target profile is absent, keep the language available for comparison and game-core practice instead of inventing a full cultural/grammar profile.
runtime_model.english_spanish_reference: English to Spanish remains the worked editorial example; it is not a runtime special case.

trust_contract.important: Game-core completeness is structural coverage, not a claim of native-speaker verification.
